entities.summary: He Yingqiang is a male Chinese weightlifter. He competed at 1988 Seoul Olympics and won a silver medal in Men's 52–56 kg. 4 years later, He won a bronze medal at 1992 Barcelona Olympics in Men's 56–60 kg.
